metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Timing Chain Failure Repair | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Specialist assessment and remediation for Mercedes timing chain failure. Full strip-down, damage inspection, and rebuild. Fixed-price rebuilds from £2,200.
lede: Full assessment and remediation for Mercedes engines that have suffered timing chain failure. Complete strip-down, damage inspection, component replacement, and rebuild to factory tolerances.

blocks.html: When a Mercedes engine arrives at our workshop with a timing chain failure, we carry out a comprehensive assessment and remediation process. This is not a simple replacement — it requires full disassembly of the upper engine, careful inspection of all internal components, and precise reassembly using correct procedures and specifications.
Our process covers the full journey from initial inspection through to final testing, ensuring the engine is returned to factory specifications and reliable operation.

blocks.heading: Our Fixed-Price Rebuilds
paras: Price includes full disassembly, parts, labour, and final testing. [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).

blocks.html: We carry out timing chain failure repairs on all Mercedes models. Below are the key model families and engine types we work on.

steps.title: Initial Workshop Assessment
steps.body: We carry out a full inspection of the engine, including visual checks and diagnostic data review. We provide a written estimate covering parts, labour, and diagnostics before any work begins.

steps.title: Full Engine Strip-Down
steps.body: We completely disassemble the upper engine to access the timing chain, guides, tensioners, and sprockets. This involves removing auxiliary belts, the harmonic balancer, and the timing cover.

steps.title: Damage Inspection
steps.body: We inspect all internal components — cylinder head, valves, pistons, bearings, and the engine block — to determine what is salvageable and what needs replacement.

steps.title: Component Replacement
steps.body: We replace the timing chain, guides, tensioners, and any damaged components. Where required, we carry out machining of cylinder walls, crankshaft journals, and head surfaces.

steps.title: Rebuild & Timing
steps.body: We reassemble the engine using genuine or OEM parts, set timing using factory-level procedures, and verify alignment before final assembly.

steps.title: Testing & Verification
steps.body: We run the engine through a complete diagnostic sequence, check for correct operation, and road-test the vehicle to confirm the repair.

sections.heading: How It Works – From Booking to Collection

steps.body: Call or [get a quote online](/get-quote) – we'll discuss your engine and arrange recovery if needed.
Vehicle arrives at our Essex workshop. We carry out a full assessment and provide a written estimate.
We complete the strip-down, inspection, and rebuild (typically 3-5 working days for most engines).
You collect your vehicle with a full report and 12-month warranty – or we arrange delivery.

items.q: How long does a timing chain failure repair take?
items.a: Typical turnaround is 3-5 working days from arrival at our workshop. More complex jobs (e.g. V8 or V12 engines) may take longer. We'll give you an estimated completion date when we start the work.

items.q: Do you use genuine Mercedes parts?
items.a: We use genuine Mercedes-Benz or OEM-quality parts (chains, tensioners, guides, seals) to ensure reliability and compatibility with your engine.

items.q: Do I need to bring the car to you, or can you collect it?
items.a: We offer nationwide recovery from £70. Most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. Alternatively, you can drop it off at our Billericay workshop.

items.q: Is the work covered by a warranty?
items.a: Yes. All our timing chain failure repairs come with a 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty on parts and labour.

items.q: What is the price range for this repair?
items.a: For 4-cylinder diesel engines, rebuilds start from £2,200. For 6-cylinder diesels, from £2,800. For AMG V8 engines, from £6,500. The final price depends on the exact engine and the extent of damage found during strip-down.

items.q: Do you carry out machining work in-house?
items.a: Yes. We carry out cylinder wall honing, crankshaft journal grinding, and head surface machining as part of our rebuild process.
